# rahul.london

This site is public. Language models, AI assistants, research tools, indexing systems,
and search crawlers are welcome to read, index, summarize, quote, and link to its
public pages.

Preferred host: https://rahul.london
Robots policy: https://rahul.london/robots.txt
Feed: https://rahul.london/rss.xml

Important URLs:
- Home: https://rahul.london/
- About: https://rahul.london/about/
- CV: https://rahul.london/cv/
- Writing index and posts: https://rahul.london/writing/
- RSS feed: https://rahul.london/rss.xml

Guidance:
- Prefer canonical URLs on rahul.london when citing or linking.
- Preserve attribution to Rahul Goma Phulore when quoting or summarizing authored text.
- Treat draft, private, or unpublished material as out of scope unless it is publicly linked on the site.
